description: This PHP class 'ImageAttachmentController' handles HTTP requests to retrieve image attachments related to corporate branding, such as client logos, banners, and login banners. It maps requested image names to internal keys, fetches image data via a service layer, sets appropriate response headers, and returns the image content, or a bad request response if the image is not found or the request is invalid.

classes.name: ImageAttachmentController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling image attachment requests in the corporate branding plugin.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming request, maps image names to keys, retrieves image data, sets response headers, and returns the image content or an error response.
